items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: we’ll teach you the tools to be the next Joshua Redman

ctx.x: I want to follow up on that, just for a moment. I’m not sure that a lot of young musicians realize what you just said. In order to play this certain kind of music you had to pay the band.

I think that’s a hard lesson when you’re coming up because you don’t realize that. I’m sure you’ll agree. I think, I don’t know the current school climate but certainly when I was coming up and speaking to musicians of my age that you kind of get sold, not overtly, but you kind of get sold at music school about you come through school and you’ll be a jazz star. That’s kind of the under-riding message. It’s not come through jazz school and be a working musician doing wedding gigs, you know? It’s come through jazz…
Are there other things that you learned, like on the bandstand or from older musicians that you had not learned in music school?
